test_run_single_problem: test the run_single_problem function that evaluates an agent on a single leaderboard problem instance
run_main: run the main entry point to execute neural testbed experiments via CLI flags
test_run_sweep: run the main function with problem_id=SWEEP to sweep over all classification_2d problem instances
test_run_single_problem_cli: run the experiment CLI with a specific problem_id and agent_name to evaluate KL quality
test_run_with_sweep_id: run the experiment with a specific sweep_id to select a non-default agent configuration
